name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: If Copper goes with Turbine, then Otis goes with Tungsten.
Copper goes with none of Otis, Dam, or Reactor.
Edison goes with either Reactor or Aluminum (but not both).

chain: Start by assuming Edison goes with Turbine.

So Edison does not go with Turbine.
